text:
Exciting, $SIVE gets their first production orders for CW DFB lasers with LiDAR.

“We are pleased to see this strategic program advance from design-win to production”. 

With opportunity for expansion given the speculated customer $AEVA is moving into CPO/NPO optical sources for hyperscalers and leveraging existing technology.

But this is great commercial validation of technology and execution so far.

That’s 1 qualification converted of many more to come, especially for AI DCs from $GFS to $JBL.
@aleabitoreddit Do you think that $AEVA will use $SIVE lasers for their $NVDA driving solution device?
@aleabitoreddit huge

I think the more exciting application is robotics/humanoids, which was mentioned in the PR.

With likely $AEVA doing FMCW LiDAR and robotics sensing with LG Innotek and others (Boston Dynamics supplier).

But hard to get visibility over what end product Sivers lasers go into. Regardless, I agree this is a huge step for $SIVE

@zaynchd $AEVA FMCW 4D LiDAR is the reference sensor for $NVDA Hyperion, so seems like a possible path.

Again, not too much visibility into suppliers or where their CW lasers ultimately end up given how sensitive supply chain relationships are

Wabi 2.0 is live!

personal agents are one person, one chat. but the parts of life that matter run on more than one person

Wabi is an agent you use together. you talk to it, it does stuff, builds the apps you need, and anyone can join the thread - your partner, your best friend, the preschool moms groupchat

school changes pickup time → Wabi updates the family calendar, everyone sees it.
a show you’d both love → Wabi finds a night that works, gets the tickets.
the trip everyone keeps talking about → Wabi picks the dates, builds the itinerary, books it

go start a thread with your people 👇
